description: Ministry of Defence - Notification to award the Videsha Sewa Paddakkama to the Air Force Personnel
categorisation: This gazette notification announces the award of the Videsha Seva Padakkama to specific named Air Force personnel (including their service numbers, ranks, and names). It involves government personnel changes (awards to military personnel) but does not include any detailed descriptions of portfolio responsibilities or government structural changes. The content focuses solely on recognizing individuals with their basic titles/ranks.
